newsitem.title: INDIA: India Bata 6-month net sharply up.
newsitem.headline: India Bata 6-month net sharply up.

text.p: India's Bata Industries said on Thursday its net profit in the six months ending June 30, 1997 had risen to 83.5 million rupees from 1.5 million rupees in the corresponding period a year ago.
The firm said its net sales surged to 3.42 billion rupees in the first six months from 2.92 billion rupees in the corresponding period a year ago.
"The upward trend towards greater profitability has been sustained with net sales improving by 17 percent from 2.92 billion rupees to 3.41 billion," Bata India said in a statement.

"The turnaround in performance is attributed to the current marketing strategy, which emphasises the introduction of low- to medium-price footwest at popular prices, together with restructuring measures and cost reduction."
Bata said its gross profit on net sales increased to 4.2 percent from 1.7 percent.
